answer_1.quote: This paper examines low-cost, zero-shot methods for LLMs to automatically generate and evaluate dictionary example sentences.

answer_2.quote: We start by defining the OxfordEval metric, which measures the win-rate of candidate dictionary example sentences... Beyond the OxfordEval metric, we also track secondary metrics that can be relevant for the selection of preferred dictionary sentences.

answer_3.quote: We apply the recent approaches in pairwise output ranking and automating evaluations by using LLM as evaluators...

answer_4.quote: To validate our approach, we (the authors) annotated 501 examples of pairwise comparison between Claude-Instant generated sentences and baseline Oxford sentences using the Amazon Sage-Maker Ground Truth platform.
